draw_hint: Hold trigger or pinch and trace a closed outline on a surface.
move_hint: Hold grip to move within this surface.
delete_hint: Hold B / Y for two seconds to delete.
object_hint: Select an icon or name, or move the thumbstick left/right. Use the launch button to confirm.
object_allowed: Available in this mission: %s. All objects are available in Free Creation.
three_star: Optimal count and time; no collisions
sandbox_hint: Draw and launch freely. No win or loss.
v_welcome: Welcome to the Gravity Lab. Choose free play, or a mission challenge.
v_scan: Take a slow look around. Scan the floor, tables, and walls. When you are ready, select continue.
v_ready: Scan complete. Your surfaces are now locked. You can start drawing portals.
v_draw: Hold the trigger, or keep pinching. Draw a closed outline.
v_closed: Portal ready. The gravitational field is stable.
v_select: Choose an object. Make sure it fits the portals, then select launch.
v_launch: Launch successful. Watch it travel through your portals.
v_loop: You have made a stable loop. The object is circulating smoothly.
v_fail: There was a collision. The experiment has stopped. Try again when you are ready.
v_move: Hold the grip button to move a portal along its current surface.
v_delete: Point at a portal. Hold the B button, or the Y button, for two seconds to delete it.
v_lost: This surface is no longer available. Please scan your surroundings again.
panel_drag: Hold grip to move. Pinch the title area to drag by hand.
scan_hint: Look around slowly and wait for detected real surfaces.
scan_real_only: Portals can only be drawn on detected real surfaces.
running: Experiment running: observe the trajectory and return.
launch_needs_fit: Meet the mission portal count and make every aperture large enough for the payload.
portal_ready: Portal anchored. Draw another or select a payload.
portal_overlap: Portals cannot overlap an existing aperture.
outside_surface: The outline leaves the detected surface. Draw inside its boundary.
invalid_shape: Draw a large closed outline without crossing the stroke.
asset_error: Asset loading failed. Restart the app and check its log.
scan_unavailable: Room scanning is unavailable. Check tracking and spatial permissions.
fit_hint: Every portal must fit the entire payload. Small apertures block launch.
reset_hint: The payload collided and fell. Reset the mission to plan again.
tutorial_practice: Practice on a real surface beside this panel, then continue.
sandbox_collision: Contact detected. Once the payload lands and portals close, keep creating.
flow_home_hint: Choose a mode to begin a spatial experiment.
flow_mode_steps: Draw portals → Choose an object → Launch and observe
flow_new_experiment_hint: This will clear your current portals. Return to keep your layout.
flow_anchor_lost: Previous portal anchors are unavailable. If they do not recover, clear the invalid layout and redraw.
flow_draw_first: Aim at a real surface and draw your first closed portal.
flow_need_more_portals: Keep drawing portals before choosing an object.
flow_need_count: Draw %d more portal(s) to choose an object.
flow_draw_ready: Your portals are ready. Keep drawing or choose an object.
flow_launch_ready: All portals fit. Use the launch button below.
flow_launch_too_small: Portal %d is too small. Choose a smaller object or go back and redraw that portal.
flow_launch_tracking: Surface tracking is unavailable. Restore the room scan.
flow_launch_loading: The spatial scene is still loading. Please wait.
flow_launch_restricted: This object is not allowed in this mission.
flow_launch_not_editing: Stop the current experiment before choosing an object.
flow_running_hint: Watch the object travel through your portals. Stop to keep and edit the layout.
flow_stopped: Experiment stopped. Your portal layout is preserved.
flow_collapsing: The object collided. Portals are collapsing…
flow_collision_redraw: Portals have collapsed. Draw a new layout to keep experimenting.
flow_layout_redraw: The invalid layout was cleared. Draw again on the detected surfaces.
flow_tracking_restored: Tracking restored. Continue where you left off.
flow_tutorial_draw: Draw at least two closed portals on real surfaces, then choose an object.
flow_tutorial_select: Select an object by its icon or name, check the fit, then use the launch button.
flow_tutorial_launch: Watch the object enter the first portal and emerge from another.
flow_tutorial_loop: Return the object to the first portal and complete one loop to finish practice.
flow_tutorial_complete: Practice complete. Keep observing, or stop and edit the layout.
